copy.headline: Mamma Mia! coming back to town
copy.caption:
Performing Arts Fort Worth, the non-profit owner and operator of Bass Performance Hall, is presenting "Mamma Mia!" Dec. 1-6 at Bass Performance Hall as part of the musical’s 25th anniversary American tour.

Following a sold-out Fort Worth engagement in 2024, this production returns fresh off a celebratory anniversary Broadway run. The ultimate feel-good show ia part of the 2026-27 Broadway at the Bass Season presented by PNC Bank.

Following a sold-out Fort Worth engagement in 2024, this production returns fresh off a celebratory anniversary Broadway run. The ultimate feel-good show ia part of the 2026-27 Broadway at the Bass Season presented by PNC Bank. Since premiering in London in 1999 and on Broadway in 2001, the irresistible musical has captured the hearts of millions around the globe. The sunny, funny tale of a mother, a daughter and three possible dads on a Greek island paradise, all unfolding to the storytelling magic of ABBA’s timeless songs…
